description: Create a new playlist in your Apple Music library, optionally with tracks (up to 500 catalog or library song ids; added 100 at a time), a description, a folder and public visibility (not in APPLE_WRITE_MODE=additive). Returns the new playlist id (p.…) and checks it by re-reading (Apple can take a few seconds to show it). Needs APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN or web-player mode.

folderId.description: Create it inside this folder (p.… from apple_music_list_folders; default the top level).

isPublic.description: Show it on your Apple Music profile (default false; needs APPLE_WRITE_MODE=all).

tracks.description: Songs to put in it, in order (up to 500).

type.description: songs / music-videos (catalog ids) or library-songs / library-music-videos (library ids).

items.description: A catalog song id (numeric), a library song id (i.…), or {id, type} (needed for music videos).

name: apple_music_create_playlist
title: Create an Apple Music playlist
